dct_description_sm: The main objectives of the Spectacled Eider survey along the Alpine Pipelines were to 1) monitor the distribution and abundance of Spectacled Eiders within an 800-m-wide (~0.5 mi) corridor surrounding the pipeline during pre-nesting; and 2) if pre-nesting Spectacled Eiders were seen on the aerial survey, conduct a ground-based nest search and monitor the fate of any nests found. The distribution and abundance of Spectacled and Steller's eiders along the other USDOT pipelines in the greater Kuparuk region were evaluated in 2011 as part of the long-term avian studies in the Kuparuk Oilfield.
dct_title_s: Alpine Pipeline Eider Surveys, North Slope, Alaska
